title: tx_queue_stats_get doc/impl mismatch on locking
description:
Header doc at lines 206-208 states 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' but implementation (tx_queue.c lines 416-430) performs raw struct assignment without acquiring the mutex. Concurrent writer causes data race.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 213
close_reason: Same root cause as project-LICHEN-worker6-a8gr; one fix covers both. Header doc 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock (no longer non-atomic)' (tx_queue.h line 214) now matches implementation: tx_queue_stats_get() acquires lock_queue()/unlock_queue() around the struct copy (tx_queue.c lines 440-442). Fix is in the current working tree, UNCOMMITTED — must be included in next commit. Verified: host cmake build 22/22 tests pass; TSAN build clean under concurrent reader thread calling stats_get/count/empty 5000x against concurrent push/pop.
